answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the whisper of free entry disappears, the quill of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the walnut case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
